outcomes.intended_user_result: A local MCP client can use the four existing Mind tools through the same service policies and durable store.
outcomes.current_baseline: MCP adapter is explicitly deferred and unavailable.
outcomes.acceptance: Disposable stdio client initializes, lists tools, calls note/recall/inspect/dream, and preserves scope and idempotency without changing native clients.

excluded_scope: No HTTP MCP, external backend, provider, proxy, model, compaction, or new Mind tool.
